title: Load and Render glTF 2.0 with Rust and WebGPU
description: Load a glTF 2.0 model from a URL with Rust, wgpu, and WebGPU. Learn scene traversal, mesh buffers, materials, textures, samplers, and WGSL lighting.
imageAlt: An angled gray cube textured with blue, green, and white Cesium logos on a dark WebGPU canvas.
